title: BLF: Support more object types
description:
With this MR, I added support to other BLF object types (closes #19390).

The last commit changes the echo of "unknown ojbect" messages from debug to info, thus allowing people on non-debug releases to filter the log for potentially useful but unsupported object types. To avoid spamming the log, some known unsupported object types are treated differently and a message is still printed as debug. All of them are unlikely to be useful to us.

I need feedback on this commit, since I thought there was no point in trying to parse a partial payload if we will then fail because of a missing trailer.
But maybe there were other reasons, so please take a look.

If there is a bugfix included, the bugfix should be a moved into a different Merge Request so that it can be cherry-picked into Wireshark 4.0 and 4.2 as needed.

This MR here should only add `BLF_OBJTYPE_LIN_MESSAGE2`.

> LIN was broken because its payload was treated as a variable length field, while it is always 8 bytes

> Fix DLC parsing to allow only 8 bytes instead of 15

Make sense to me. It seems that I complete missed that, when I was writing the code a long time ago. :disappointed: Should be a different MR though.


I checked a few traces and the code does not seem to break anything obvious. The traces I have do not really have checksums set, so I cannot see the effect of the fix.
Please remove the TODO since it would be a really bad idea to generate the parity bits, if they are not known.

If I understand correctly (I jump in a running train here and I do not know anything regarding BLF so please be patient ;)) this is a new field added in v1, and the call to tvb_captured_length() used to identify v0 vs v1. There is no other field provided the version that could be used instead of this bound check? Right now a malformed packet with a wrong linkUpDuration field would be skipped instead of triggering a dissection error.

Yes, this in correct. Unfortunately, the version field is in an upper header. Maybe we could rewrite the `blf-ethernetstatus-obj` buffer layout to include the upper header (or just the version field), but it would break compatibility.
For reference (I'm not asking to make any change) both calls could have been combined in a single proto_tree_add_bitmask_list_ret_uint64() call.
